title: Normalized presentations for exceptional reconstruction
statement: Using the coefficient, realization and strict-system interfaces [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization], [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit], [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization], [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], [def-pur-etale-tower-brown-adjunction-data], [lem-pur-finite-coefficient-adjoint-comparisons], [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison], [def-pur-exceptional-system-transport-interfaces], [def-pur-clopen-strict-system-comparison], define the canonical lifted Q_l coefficient field, its embedding into the fixed algebraic closure, and U_T as rationalization, the specified realization, and derived scalar extension. The complex-square map applies an ordinary natural comparison termwise. Its localization-square predicate requires equality of the two composites through the four specified localization factorizations. The section-value graph records equality of an input section and its mapped value across equivalent coefficient presentations. These constructions define the representative normalization for ordinary strict-system inverse-image presentation comparisons.
